_comment: GENERATED by `python3 -m edge_workbench check`. Do not edit:
re-run it. This is what the build reads instead of the
tutorial, so that a build depends on files in this repository
and not on which branch a sibling checkout happens to be on.
`source.sha` is the commit the tutorial was read at. A gate
compares it against the tutorial's head to tell you when the
tutorial has moved and this needs re-running.
`gaps` lists what the tutorial does not state in a form this
step can read. Those are the model-assisted half's input; an
empty list means the tutorial said everything itself.

meanings.E01: On the first pass each step compares the value carried so far with the next element of the input, keeping the smaller on the left and the larger on the right.
meanings.E02: A later pass starts from the row the previous pass ended with, sorting its first two positions and copying the rest.
meanings.E03: On later passes the element coming in at each step is the next cell of the previous pass's final row.
meanings.init: The sort starts by putting the first two input values in order.
meanings.stop: The passes end when a whole sweep leaves the array unchanged, which means it is sorted.

tensorNotes.Z: the value at each position after each step of each pass

quotes.E01:
Each step $j$ carries the already-settled left region forward, compares the
  running value at position $j$ against the next array element $A_{j+1}$, and
  writes $\min$ to position $j$ and $\max$ to position $j+1$.
quotes.E02:
Each later pass $i$ instead reads pass $i-1$'s
  final row
quotes.E03:
The incoming element $R$ is $A_{j+1}$ on pass $0$ (still bubbling through the raw
  input) and $Z_{i-1,\,J-1,\,j+1}$ on later passes
quotes.init:
Pass $0$ reads the raw input:
  $\min(A_0, A_1)$ lands at position $0$ and $\max(A_0, A_1)$ at position $1$;
quotes.stop:
The pass cascade
  halts when a whole sweep produces no change, i.e. the array is sorted.
